stages.name: Predictor Championship
stages.blockedBy: Stage 12's surface merged in #913, but its minimum completion predicate is NOT satisfied: it requires eliminated/champion/no-action-required states to be complete, and no season Championship read this surface can call returns bonus_competition_entrants.outcome. The surface states what an authority states and stays silent otherwise rather than deriving elimination from a lost tie. docs/product/vnext-championship.md section 6 records the owed backend read delta and names the smallest candidate. Migrations are another session's work. Stage 12 is not merged and Stage 13 does not start until that delta lands.
stages.remainingInScopeWork: docs/product/vnext-championship.md section 8.5 — contract 133 get_season_cup_player_view is not consumed, and cannot be for the split case: it takes its group from contract 120 get_season_cup_phase, whose membership lookup has no phase_kind filter, no order by and no limit. bonus_cup_members is keyed (competition_id, user_id, phase_kind) per contract 102, so a split entrant holds two rows and a plain SELECT INTO takes one silently — proved on PostgreSQL 16, it returns the PRE-SPLIT group. Contract 205's defect in a quieter form, and contract 120 is called in production at src/services/supabase/seasonCup.ts:88. This is a SECOND owed backend delta, not frontend work.
